family: The single total uniform norm-one finite-field predicate of proof.md Section A: f_n=0 for n<64; otherwise construct its deterministic quadratic-tower binary basis of dimension m=n-o(n), ignore the remaining tail bits, and accept exactly when z^((2^m-1)/(2^k-1))=1, with the exact all-length parameters defined there.
theorem: For this fixed polynomial-time computable family with an empty-witness NP verifier, there is an integer N_0 such that for every actual length N>=N_0 every unrestricted deterministic exact full-B2 circuit has at least (628119274124457367309274931/123070533181185612740000000)*N gates.
